en: Hello and welcome to HistoryPod.
zh: 您好，歡迎來到 HistoryPod。
ja: こんにちは、HistoryPodへようこそ。
local: Hello and welcome to HistoryPod.
ja_pron: Konnichiwa, HistoryPod e youkoso.
native: Hello and welcome to HistoryPod.

en: On the 10th of March 1876, Scottish-born inventor Alexander Graham Bell made the first successful
zh: 1876年3月10日，出生於蘇格蘭的發明家亞歷山大·格雷厄姆·貝爾完成了第一次成功的
ja: 1876年3月10日、スコットランド生まれの発明家アレクサンダー・グラハム・ベルが最初の成功した
local: On the 10th of March 1876, Scottish-born inventor Alexander Graham Bell made the first successful
ja_pron: 1876-nen 3-gatsu 10-nichi, Sukottorando umare no hatsumeika Arekusandā Gurahamu Beru ga saisho no seikō shita
native: On the 10th of March 1876, Scottish-born inventor Alexander Graham Bell made the first successful

en: telephone call when he contacted his assistant, Thomas Watson.
zh: 電話通話，當時他聯絡了他的助手湯瑪斯·沃森。
ja: 電話の通話を行い、助手のトーマス・ワトソンに連絡しました。
local: telephone call when he contacted his assistant, Thomas Watson.
ja_pron: Denwa no tsūwa o okonai, joshu no Tōmasu Watoson ni renraku shimashita.
native: telephone call when he contacted his assistant, Thomas Watson.

en: Bell moved with his family to Canada when he was 23 years old.
zh: 貝爾23歲時，與家人一起移居加拿大。
ja: ベルは23歳の時に家族と共にカナダに移住しました。
local: Bell moved with his family to Canada when he was 23 years old.
ja_pron: Beru wa 23-sai no toki ni kazoku to tomo ni Kanada ni ijū shimashita.
native: Bell moved with his family to Canada when he was 23 years old.

en: Here, he continued his previous work on hearing and speech.
zh: 在這裡，他繼續從事先前關於聽覺和語言的研究。
ja: ここで彼は聴覚と言語に関する以前の研究を続けました。
local: Here, he continued his previous work on hearing and speech.
ja_pron: Koko de kare wa chōkaku to gengo ni kansuru izen no kenkyū o tsuzukemashita.
native: Here, he continued his previous work on hearing and speech.

en: His father was a renowned politician, and his mother had gradually become deaf through
zh: 他的父親是一位著名的政治家，而他的母親在青少年時期逐漸失聰。
ja: 彼の父親は著名な政治家で、母親は思春期を通じて徐々に聴覚を失いました。
local: His father was a renowned politician, and his mother had gradually become deaf through
ja_pron: Kare no chichioya wa chomei na seijika de, hahaoya wa shishunki o tsūjite jojo ni chōkaku o ushinai mashita.
native: His father was a renowned politician, and his mother had gradually become deaf through

en: her teenage years.
zh: 她的青少年時期。
ja: 彼女の思春期の間に。
local: her teenage years.
ja_pron: Kanojo no shishunki no aida ni.
native: her teenage years.

en: Both parents had a strong impact on their son's work, but by 1871, however, Bell had moved
zh: 雙親都對兒子的工作有深遠影響，但到了1871年，貝爾已經搬到
ja: 両親は息子の仕事に強い影響を与えましたが、1871年までにベルは移動していました。
local: Both parents had a strong impact on their son's work, but by 1871, however, Bell had moved
ja_pron: Ryōshin wa musuko no shigoto ni tsuyoi eikyō o ataemashita ga, 1871-nen made ni Beru wa idō shite imashita.
native: Both parents had a strong impact on their son's work, but by 1871, however, Bell had moved

en: away to Boston, where he trained teachers of the deaf.
zh: 波士頓，在那裡他培訓聽障教師。
ja: ボストンに移り、そこで聴覚障害者の教師を訓練しました。
local: away to Boston, where he trained teachers of the deaf.
ja_pron: Bosuton ni utsuri, soko de chōkaku shōgaisha no kyōshi o kunren shimashita.
native: away to Boston, where he trained teachers of the deaf.

en: It was while in Boston that Bell's experiments with sound waves and electricity led to
zh: 正是在波士頓，貝爾對聲波和電力的實驗促成了
ja: ボストンにいた時、ベルの音波と電気に関する実験が
local: It was while in Boston that Bell's experiments with sound waves and electricity led to
ja_pron: Bosuton ni ita toki, Beru no onpa to denki ni kansuru jikken ga
native: It was while in Boston that Bell's experiments with sound waves and electricity led to

en: his development of a telegraph-like system to transmit the vibrations associated with speech.
zh: 他開發出一種類似電報的系統，用來傳送與語音相關的振動。
ja: 彼の音声に関連する振動を伝える電信のようなシステムの開発につながりました。
local: his development of a telegraph-like system to transmit the vibrations associated with speech.
ja_pron: Kare no onsei ni kanren suru shindō o tsutaeru denshin no yō na shisutemu no kaihatsu ni tsunagarimashita.
native: his development of a telegraph-like system to transmit the vibrations associated with speech.

en: His harmonic telegraph was patented on the same day as fellow inventor Alicia Gray
zh: 他的和聲電報在同一天獲得專利，當天另一位發明家艾莉西亞·格雷也提交了類似的申請。
ja: 彼のハーモニックテレグラフは、同じ日に発明家アリシア・グレイが類似の申請を提出した日と重なりました。
local: His harmonic telegraph was patented on the same day as fellow inventor Alicia Gray
ja_pron: Kare no hāmonikku teregurafu wa, onaji hi ni hatsumeika Arishia Gurei ga ruiji no shinsei o teishutsu shita hi to kasanari mashita.
native: His harmonic telegraph was patented on the same day as fellow inventor Alicia Gray

en: filed a similar caveat with the US Patent Office.
zh: 向美國專利局提交了類似的警告申請。
ja: 米国特許庁に類似の警告申請を提出しました。
local: filed a similar caveat with the US Patent Office.
ja_pron: Beikoku tokkyochō ni ruiji no keikoku shinsei o teishutsu shimashita.
native: filed a similar caveat with the US Patent Office.

en: Although Bell was awarded patent 174-465 on 7 March for his invention, there continues
zh: 儘管貝爾於3月7日獲得了174-465號專利，但仍然
ja: ベルは3月7日に174-465号の特許を取得しましたが、依然として
local: Although Bell was awarded patent 174-465 on 7 March for his invention, there continues
ja_pron: Beru wa 3-gatsu 7-nichi ni 174-465-gō no tokky o shutoku shimashita ga, izen to shite
native: Although Bell was awarded patent 174-465 on 7 March for his invention, there continues

en: to be considerable debate over whether Bell stole the telephone from Gray.
zh: 關於貝爾是否從格雷那裡竊取電話的爭議仍然很大。
ja: ベルがグレイから電話を盗んだかどうかについてはかなりの議論があります。
local: to be considerable debate over whether Bell stole the telephone from Gray.
ja_pron: Beru ga Gurei kara denwa o nusunda ka dō ka ni tsuite wa kanari no giron ga arimasu.
native: to be considerable debate over whether Bell stole the telephone from Gray.

en: It wasn't until three days later, while using a liquid transmitter similar to Gray's
zh: 直到三天後，當他使用類似格雷的液體傳送器時，
ja: それは3日後のことで、グレイのものに似た液体送信機を使用していた時でした。
local: It wasn't until three days later, while using a liquid transmitter similar to Gray's
ja_pron: Sore wa mikka go no koto de, Gurei no mono ni nita ekitai sōshinki o shiyō shite ita toki deshita.
native: It wasn't until three days later, while using a liquid transmitter similar to Gray's

en: design that Bell succeeded in getting his idea to work.
zh: 貝爾才成功讓他的想法實現。
ja: ベルは自分のアイデアを実現させることに成功しました。
local: design that Bell succeeded in getting his idea to work.
ja_pron: Beru wa jibun no aidea o jitsugen saseru koto ni seikō shimashita.
native: design that Bell succeeded in getting his idea to work.

en: He recorded in his journal that he shouted the phrase, Mr. Watson, come here I want to
zh: 他在日記中記錄說他喊出了這句話：「沃森先生，過來，我想要
ja: 彼は日記に「ワトソンさん、こっちに来てほしい」と叫んだと記録しました。
local: He recorded in his journal that he shouted the phrase, Mr. Watson, come here I want to
ja_pron: Kare wa nikki ni 'Watoson-san, kocchi ni kite hoshii' to sakenda to kiroku shimashita.
native: He recorded in his journal that he shouted the phrase, Mr. Watson, come here I want to

en: see you.
zh: 見你。」
ja: 会いたい」と。
local: see you.
ja_pron: Aitai" to.
native: see you.

en: Watson soon appeared, saying that he heard the words clearly through the device.
zh: 沃森很快出現，說他透過裝置清楚地聽到了這些話。
ja: ワトソンはすぐに現れ、その装置を通して言葉をはっきり聞いたと言いました。
local: Watson soon appeared, saying that he heard the words clearly through the device.
ja_pron: Watoson wa sugu ni araware, sono sōchi o tōshite kotoba o hakkiri kiita to iimashita.
native: Watson soon appeared, saying that he heard the words clearly through the device.

en: Despite legal challenges, the courts always upheld Bell's claim to the invention.
zh: 儘管有法律挑戰，法院始終支持貝爾對該發明的主張。
ja: 法的な挑戦にもかかわらず、裁判所は常にベルの発明の権利を支持しました。
local: Despite legal challenges, the courts always upheld Bell's claim to the invention.
ja_pron: Hōteki na chōsen ni mo kakawarazu, saiban-sho wa tsune ni Beru no hatsumei no kenri o shiji shimashita.
native: Despite legal challenges, the courts always upheld Bell's claim to the invention.

en: Bell never used the liquid transmitter in public demonstrations, focusing instead on his
zh: 貝爾從未在公開展示中使用液體傳送器，而是專注於他的
ja: ベルは公開実演で液体送信機を使用せず、代わりに彼の
local: Bell never used the liquid transmitter in public demonstrations, focusing instead on his
ja_pron: Beru wa kōkai jitsuen de ekitai sōshinki o shiyō sezu, kawari ni kare no
native: Bell never used the liquid transmitter in public demonstrations, focusing instead on his

en: own electromagnetic design.
zh: 自己的電磁設計。
ja: 自身の電磁設計に集中しました。
local: own electromagnetic design.
ja_pron: Jishin no denji sekkei ni shūchū shimashita.
native: own electromagnetic design.

en: The fellow inventor Thomas Alva Edison later made a significant improvement to this, with
zh: 後來，同為發明家的托馬斯·阿爾瓦·愛迪生對此做出了重大改進，
ja: 後に発明家のトーマス・アルバ・エジソンがこれに大きな改良を加えました。
local: The fellow inventor Thomas Alva Edison later made a significant improvement to this, with
ja_pron: Ato ni hatsumeika no Tōmasu Aruba Ejison ga kore ni ōkina kairyō o kuwaemashita.
native: The fellow inventor Thomas Alva Edison later made a significant improvement to this, with

en: his invention, of the carbon microphone.
zh: 他的發明——碳質麥克風。
ja: 彼の発明であるカーボンマイクロフォンです。
local: his invention, of the carbon microphone.
ja_pron: Kare no hatsumei de aru kābon maikurofon desu.
native: his invention, of the carbon microphone.
